title: Search/IR — BM25 + dense hybrid retrieval (query-by-document)
honesty_guards: (a) Retrieval is QUERY-BY-DOCUMENT: the query is the user's last-read item text (more-like-this / related-item search), NOT a free-text query.
(b) NDCG@K and MRR are SINGLE-RELEVANT: one held-out gold per user, no graded relevance. NDCG@20=1/log2(rank+1) if gold in top-K; MRR=1/rank.
(c) Served-c2 metrics only; V1 RecSys claims and V1 status are untouched.

hybrid.fusion: Reciprocal Rank Fusion (RRF, c=60) over BM25 + dense

interpretation: On seed-item (query-by-document) retrieval, BM25 lexical is the STRONGEST single lane (R@20 0.0133 vs dense 0.0067): shared series/genre tokens on short title+shelves text are a strong more-like-this signal. RRF hybrid is a ROBUST MIDDLE (0.0117) — it does NOT beat BM25 alone here, because fusing the weaker dense lane dilutes the stronger lexical signal. Both reach item-cold-start (BM25 0.0147, dense 0.0074). This is the standard two-stage-search lexical+dense+RRF front end, reported with search-standard NDCG@K + MRR (single-relevant). Honest reading: lexical wins on short-text query-by-document; hybrid buys robustness, not a recall win.

claim_status.safe_claim: Built a two-stage-search-style retrieval front end on the item catalog: BM25 lexical + dense semantic retrieval fused with RRF, evaluated with search-standard NDCG@K and MRR alongside Recall@K, using seed-item (query-by-document) queries. Offline, served-c2 — not free-text query search and not online.

bm25_latency_caveat: BM25 p95 ~63ms is a pure-Python rank_bm25 artifact; a production lexical index (Lucene/Elasticsearch/bm25s) serves this in sub-millisecond. Latency here is not a production benchmark.
sample_note: 600 seed-item users (BM25 get_scores ~43ms/query bounds the sample); relative comparison, not a precision benchmark.
best_by_recall@20_note: bm25 strongest single lane on this seed-item task; hybrid is robust-middle, not a winner.
